messages.subject: help with child documents
parts:
I am working in the second edition of my book "Investing in Mortgage and Asset Backed Securities Using R and Open Source"  The book is in Tex and there is a package I have written for the book.  The organization strategy uses child documents.  I have been able to use knitr in the second edition showing code etc.  I have quite a few graphs and would also like to use knitr in the document for the graphs but there seems to be a trick to get this to work with child documents.  Has anyone done this?

Glenn
